body.name: Tidal Arcane Gloves
body.description: Gloves crafted with added essence of Tidestone. They enhance the wearer’s spell power but are vulnerable to heat and can be easily damaged by fire.

body.name: Tidal Buttoned Boots
body.description: Boots distinguished by finely crafted Tidestone buttons. They wrap the ankles firmly, highlighting a sleek and stylish line.

body.name: Tidal Cloak
body.description: This cloak woven with Tidestone powder bears subtle wave-like patterns. Underwater it moves with the flow and does not hinder the wearer’s movements.

body.name: Tidal Coif
body.description: A coif woven with powdered Tidestone. It bears a soft teal hue, allowing the wearer to retain clarity even in the depths of the sea.

body.name: Tidal Crystal Ball
body.description: A crystal orb refined from Tidestone. When used the orb swirls with wave-like currents of energy enhancing the caster’s focus.

body.name: Tidal Elkwood Crown
body.description: A crown of sturdy leather infused with the spirit of the sea. Its delicate Tidestone horn adornments shine with a blue, watery light.

body.name: Tidal Elkwood Gloves
body.description: Vambraces reinforced with rivets sharply cut from Tidestone. Underwater, the rivets blend with the surrounding hues, yet glimmer softly like fish scales when touched by light.

body.name: Tidal Falchion
body.description: A falchion forged from sharply honed Tidestone. Its weight remains substantial, yet it moves more smoothly underwater. The broad teal blade shimmers with an iridescent glow whenever it catches the light.

body.name: Tidal Jester Cap
body.description: A whimsical jester’s cap. The Tidestone beads at the tips of its horns shimmer with a gentle light even beneath the water.

body.name: Tidal Kris Dagger
body.description: A kris dagger forged from refined Tidestone. The pale teal blade bears the stone’s distinctive wave patterns and its color lightens underwater making it hard to notice.

body.name: Tidal Light Gauntlets
body.description: Gauntlets crafted from a lightweight alloy infused with Tidestone. Designed for effortless movement even underwater.

body.name: Tidal Occultist Boots
body.description: Boots finished with a coating of Tidestone powder over sturdy fabric. With each step, a faint teal glow shimmers across their surface, evoking a sense of quiet mystique.

body.name: Tidal Plate Boots
body.description: Boots forged from refined Tidestone. Their weight allows steady movement underwater, though they offer little speed.

body.name: Tidal Plate Pants
body.description: These plate leggings forged from Tidestone possess formidable defense equal to their heavy weight and allow somewhat smoother movement underwater.

body.name: Tidal Prowler Gloves
body.description: Leather gloves treated with Tidestone powder. They are less affected by water currents, allowing agile and precise movement even underwater.

body.name: Tidal Regal Gambeson
body.description: This garment enhanced with Tidestone powder offers a comfortable fit along with excellent water resistance and keeps the wearer comfortable even when wet.

body.name: Tidal Scaled Armor
body.description: This armor made from thinly forged Tidestone scales possesses sturdy defense and allows natural movement even in rough currents.

body.name: Tidal Sleek Hide Pants
body.description: Leather pants polished with Tidestone powder. They bear a teal sheen and resist discoloration even when wet.

body.name: Tidal Spangenhelm
body.description: A helmet crafted from layered plates forged out of refined Tidestone ingots. Faint traces of wave-like patterns remain upon its surface.

body.name: Tidal Sturdy Boots
body.description: Boots enhanced with Tidestone powder for slight water resistance. The thick lining offers protection but adds extra weight.

body.name: Tidal Timeworn Robe
body.description: This robe is adorned with turquoise patterns embroidered in Tidestone threads. It is sturdily crafted to withstand the passage of time without fraying.

body.name: Tidal Trunk Hose
body.description: These pants made with added Tidestone powder dry quickly when wet, and their puffed silhouette naturally restores itself, providing a consistently fresh and comfortable wear.

body.name: Tidal Visored Sallet
body.description: Forged from Tidestone, this sallet endures the roughest currents, steadfastly shielding the wearer’s head.

body.name: Tidal Wanderer Attire
body.description: This worn outfit, enhanced with Tidestone powder, possesses a slight degree of water resistance.

body.name: Tidestone Ingot
body.description: A highly enriched ingot of pure Tidestone.
